body.condition: For every law under consideration, every cohort \(s\), and almost every admissible realized query \(z_0\) under its marginal query law, the conditional design sequence \((X_{st})_{t=1}^{T}\) given \(z_0\) has beta-mixing coefficients satisfying \(\beta_s(k\mid z_0)\le\beta_0\rho_0^k\) for every \(k\ge1\); the same envelope is uniform over laws, cohorts, and such query values.

novel.justification: Only the design sequence is conditionally beta mixing; response dependence within a unit history remains unrestricted.  A panel law provides this property only at marginal-almost-every query, while the fixed-query class imposes it pointwise.
